cases.locks: unchanged size keeps wrap_pending and the pending combining attachment alive

1-col shrink keeps leftmost cell, drops the rest with no later recovery; soft-wrap provenance survives but the join is severed by the crop flag; cursor clamps to col 0; wide scalar rejected in strict; byte-wise and split feeds agree with single-shot
height crop drops the soft successor below the cursor without counting it as history eviction; the spent identity is never resurrected and growth mints fresh strictly-increasing ids

80x24 -> 1x1 -> 80x24 keeps only the cursor-row leftmost cell, retains top rows as 1-column history, growth adds fresh blank rows without pulling history back, and the physical resize never changes the buffer epoch
20x (60x12 <-> 100x30) keeps the top-row identity stable and preserves all structural invariants
resize clears a delayed wrap and resets DECSTBM margins to the full screen while the terminal-wide origin bit stays set; the DSR reply changes from (1;5R) to (2;5R) through the reset region
invalid sizes (0/201 rows, 0/501 columns) leave the 1x1 extreme state untouched
